definition_all6: absolute value of six-mode amplitude-weighted SIGNED mean, not weighted mean absolute angles
target_error_policy: Preserved, unweighted OLS; neither axis uncertainties propagated
limitations: Exploratory internal leave-one-galaxy-out validation, not external validation.
Common cohort excludes unmeasurable/invalid cases; not representative of every spiral galaxy.
Fourier amplitudes and bootstrap intervals are not probabilities that a pitch is correct.
Signed all-mode cancellation can produce a small magnitude without any tight physical arm.
Flag subsets are secondary; no selection of the best-looking subset.

paired_uncertainty.difference_direction: First method minus second; negative MAE/RMSE/residual-SD differences favor the first.
paired_uncertainty.bootstrap_scope: Paired galaxy bootstrap of frozen out-of-fold residual vectors. Conditional on these predictions; it does not refit the estimator and is not a calibrated generalization interval.
paired_uncertainty.jackknife_scope: Delete one whole galaxy, rerun every LOOCV fit on the retained common cases, then compute the paired difference. Normal intervals are small-sample descriptive approximations.
paired_uncertainty.limitations: Methods share galaxies and training data; no independence assumption between methods. No multiplicity correction. Measurement and target-mass uncertainties are not propagated.
